definition_zh: 贡献；捐款；来稿；促成作用
definition_en: something given to help a shared purpose, or the act of giving it
core_image: 一只罐子里叠着许多不同面额的硬币
scene: 会后名单贴在墙上，每个名字后面写着金额。Her contribution made the project possible.
sceneCN: 这里 contribution 指「捐款」（第 2 个义项：为某项事业拿出的款项）；句意是她的捐款让这个项目得以启动。

pos.zh: 贡献；捐款；来稿；促成作用

senses.title: A share given
senses.definition: something valuable that a person gives to a shared effort
senses.definitionCN: 个人为共同事业拿出的有价值之物
senses.example: Her contribution to the team was never forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 她对团队的贡献从未被忘记。
senses.why: A group remembers what one pair of hands added.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体会记住某一双手添了什么。

senses.title: Money given
senses.definition: a sum of money given to a cause or a group
senses.definitionCN: 为某项事业或团体拿出的款项
senses.example: The school asked for a small contribution.
senses.exampleCN: 学校请求大家小额捐款。
senses.why: Coins in a box become a building in time.
senses.whyCN: 盒子里的硬币，久了会变成一座楼。

senses.title: A piece written
senses.definition: a text sent to a paper, magazine or collection
senses.definitionCN: 寄给报刊或文集的文章
senses.example: The magazine printed four contributions.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志刊出了四篇来稿。
senses.why: A page is a meeting place, not a single voice.
senses.whyCN: 一个版面是聚会的场所，不只是一个人的声音。

intro.en: Contribution comes from Latin contributio, a bringing together of shares, from contribuere, built on com-, together, and tribuere, to allot.
intro.cn: contribution 来自拉丁语 contributio（各份的汇集），源于 contribuere，由 com-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

items.en: Tribuere meant to assign a part to each person.
items.cn: tribuere 意为给每人分配一份。

items.en: Contribuere meant to bring those parts into one place.
items.cn: contribuere 意为把各份带到一个地方。

items.en: Contributio named the common fund so formed.
items.cn: contributio 指这样形成的公库。

items.en: French contribution kept the sense of a paid share.
items.cn: 法语 contribution 保留了缴付一份的意思。

items.en: English contribution widened to effort and writing.
items.cn: 英语 contribution 扩大到力气与文字。

items.en: It now also names a single act of helping.
items.cn: 如今它也指一次具体的帮忙。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin allotting base tribut-, and the meaning group names other words for what is given to a shared end.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的分配词基 tribut-，近义组列出其他表示为共同目标给出的东西。

entries.definition: to give a share to a common purpose
a person who gives or writes for others
the handing out of things to many people
money or goods given to a cause
something put in to help a process
a part that belongs to one person

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with value added by one pair of hands, then move to coins in a box and an article sent to a page.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一双添上的手开始，再到盒子里的硬币，最后到寄给版面的文章。

normal.en: Contribution is the noun behind contribute: the thing you put in.
normal.cn: contribution 是 contribute 背后的名词：你放进去的那样东西。

normal.en: A team remembers the one who carried the water.
normal.cn: 一个团队会记住那个挑水的人。

normal.en: Small coins in a box become walls in time.
normal.cn: 盒子里的零钱，日子久了会变成墙。

normal.en: An article is also a dish on a shared table.
normal.cn: 一篇文章也是公共餐桌上的一道菜。

normal.en: Give a part, and the whole is different.
normal.cn: 给出一份，整体就不一样了。

abstract.en: Picture one coin resting on a tall pile.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币落在高高的一堆上。

abstract.en: Picture a name written under a given sum.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字写在一笔金额之下。

abstract.en: Picture many pens filling one printed page.
abstract.cn: 想象许多支笔写满同一个版面。

examples.en: He made a real contribution to the research.
examples.cn: 他对这项研究作出了真正的贡献。

examples.en: A small contribution from each member was enough.
examples.cn: 每位成员捐一点就够了。

examples.en: The paper welcomes contributions from readers.
examples.cn: 这份报纸欢迎读者来稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contribution 记成 contribute（贡献）加 ion（名词尾）：大家各出一份凑起来的那个东西，就是贡献。

root: 源自拉丁语 contributio（各份的汇集），来自 contribuere（把份额凑到一起），由 con-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

sensesIntro.en: From a valuable share, to a sum of money, and at last to a piece of writing sent to a page.
sensesIntro.cn: 从有价值的一份，到一笔钱，最后到寄给版面的文字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one coin laid on a tall stack of coins.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币放在高高的一摞硬币上。

branches.en: The widest sense covers any valuable share.
branches.cn: 最宽的义项涵盖任何有价值的一份。

branches.en: Money is the shape this share most often takes.
branches.cn: 钱是这一份最常见的形状。

branches.en: A written piece is a share of words.
branches.cn: 一篇文字是文字上的一份。

branches.en: Effort and money both fill the same pool.
branches.cn: 力气和钱都往同一个池子里倒。

branches.en: A gift and a column both reach other people.
branches.cn: 捐款与专栏最后都到了别人手里。

intro.en: Contribution is built on contribute plus the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: contribution 由 contribute 加名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The allotting base tribut- also appears in tribute, distribute and attribute.
latinIntro.cn: 分配词基 tribut- 也出现在 tribute、distribute 与 attribute 中。

items.meaning: the share that has been given
items.exampleCN: 这笔捐助被记录了下来。

items.example: The delay was a contributory cause.
They paid tribute to the old teacher.

items.meaning: to give a cause to something
items.example: He attributes the win to practice.

definition_zh: 贡献者；捐款者；投稿人；促成因素
definition_en: a person or thing that contributes something, especially money, articles, or effort; a factor that helps cause something
core_image: 一个人把自己的一份放进共同的篮子
scene: 这组词中，She is a regular contributor to the magazine's science section.
sceneCN: 这里 contributor 是「投稿人」（第 3 个义项：投稿的人）；句意：她是该杂志科学栏目的常驻投稿人。图中可辨识物件：杂志、信封、打字机、作者。

senses.title: A person who gives something
senses.definition: a person who gives something such as money, time, or ideas to help a common purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为帮助共同目的而给予金钱、时间或想法等东西的人
senses.example: The charity thanked all its contributors.
senses.exampleCN: 慈善机构感谢了所有捐款者。
senses.why: contribuere 'to give a share' + -or 'one who does': a contributor is one who gives a share.
senses.whyCN: contribuere「出一份」+ -or「做……的人」：contributor 是出一份的人。

senses.title: A person who donates money
senses.definition: a person who gives money to a fund, charity, or political campaign
senses.definitionCN: 向基金、慈善机构或政治运动捐钱的人
senses.example: The foundation lists its top contributors each year.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金会每年列出其主要捐款者。
senses.why: When the contribution is money, the contributor is a donor.
senses.whyCN: 当 contribution 是金钱时，contributor 就是捐赠者。

senses.title: A person who writes for publication
senses.definition: a person who submits articles or other writing to a publication
senses.definitionCN: 向出版物投送文章或其他文字的人
senses.example: He is a frequent contributor to this newspaper.
senses.exampleCN: 他是本报的频繁撰稿人。
senses.why: A contributor to a magazine 'brings' written pieces to it.
senses.whyCN: 杂志的 contributor 把书面作品「带来」给它。

senses.title: A factor that helps cause an outcome
senses.definition: something that helps cause or influence a result
senses.definitionCN: 帮助导致或影响结果的事物
senses.example: Smoking is a major contributor to lung cancer.
senses.exampleCN: 吸烟是肺癌的主要促成因素。
senses.why: By extension, a non-person that 'brings' an influence is also a contributor.
senses.whyCN: 引申而言，「带来」影响的非人物也可以是 contributor。

senses.title: A person who pays into a fund
senses.definition: a person who makes regular payments into a pension or insurance fund
senses.definitionCN: 定期向养老或保险基金付款的人
senses.example: All contributors to the plan receive annual statements.
senses.exampleCN: 该计划的所有出资人每年都收到对账单。
senses.why: In finance, contributors are those who pay into a shared fund.
senses.whyCN: 在财务中，contributors 是向共同基金付款的人。

senses.title: A participant in a project
senses.definition: a person who takes part in and helps with a project or activity
senses.definitionCN: 参与并帮助项目或活动的人
senses.example: She was a contributor to the research paper.
senses.exampleCN: 她是这篇研究论文的参与者。
senses.why: Anyone who adds work to a project is a contributor.
senses.whyCN: 任何为项目添砖加瓦的人都是 contributor。

senses.title: A contributing cause or source
senses.definition: a cause or source that adds to a particular result
senses.definitionCN: 添加到特定结果中的原因或来源
senses.example: Stress is a known contributor to high blood pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 压力是已知的高血压成因之一。
senses.why: This sense treats the cause as something that 'contributes' to the outcome.
senses.whyCN: 此义把原因当作对结果「作出贡献」的东西。

senses.title: A writer listed by a publication
senses.definition: a writer whose work appears in a publication, often listed by name
senses.definitionCN: 作品出现在出版物中、常被列明姓名的作者
senses.example: The issue features contributors from three continents.
senses.exampleCN: 这期杂志有来自三大洲的作者。
senses.why: In publishing, contributors are the named writers of pieces.
senses.whyCN: 在出版业中，contributors 是作品署名的作者。

intro.en: Contributor is contribute + -or. Contribute comes from Latin contribuere 'to bring together, give a share' (con- + tribuere). The suffix -or marks the agent.
intro.cn: contributor 是 contribute + -or。contribute 来自拉丁 contribuere「聚到一起、出一份」（con- + tribuere）。后缀 -or 标记施动者。

items.en: tribuere 'to assign, allot' is the base, linked to tribus 'tribe'.
items.cn: tribuere「分配、分派」是词根，与 tribus「部落」相关联。

items.en: con- adds 'together'. contribuere = 'to bring together, give a share'.
items.cn: con- 加上「一起」。contribuere =「聚到一起、出一份」。

items.en: Contribute entered English in the 16th century from Latin contributus.
items.cn: contribute 在 16 世纪从拉丁 contributus 进入英语。

items.en: The suffix -or (from Latin -or) makes a noun for the person who performs the action.
items.cn: 后缀 -or（来自拉丁 -or）构成执行动作的人的名词。

items.en: contributor = contribute + -or, meaning 'one who contributes'.
items.cn: contributor = contribute + -or，意为「贡献的人」。

items.en: The word extended from people to things that cause outcomes.
items.cn: 该词从人扩展到导致结果的事物。

note.en: The first group shares tribuere; the second contains near-synonyms for giver or cause.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tribuere；第二组是给予者或原因的近义词。

entries.definition: to give a share; the verb behind contributor
entries.definitionCN: 出一份；contributor 背后的动词

entries.definition: the thing contributed; the noun of the action
entries.definitionCN: 所贡献之物；动作的名词

entries.definition: a person who gives something, especially money; close to the financial sense
entries.definitionCN: 给予某物的人，尤指金钱；接近财务义

entries.definition: a writer of a book or article; close to the publishing sense
entries.definitionCN: 书或文章的作者；接近出版义

entries.definition: a circumstance that contributes to a result; close to the causal sense
entries.definitionCN: 促成结果的情况；接近因果义

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分和真实同族词。

normal.en: contribute (verb) + -or (person): contributor = the person who contributes.
normal.cn: contribute（动词）+ -or（人）：contributor = 贡献的人。

normal.en: A contributor gives a share of money, time, ideas, or writing.
normal.cn: contributor 出一份金钱、时间、想法或文字。

normal.en: distributor is one who distributes; contributor is one who contributes.
normal.cn: distributor 是分发的人；contributor 是贡献的人。

normal.en: A 'regular contributor' writes often for a publication.
normal.cn: 「regular contributor」是经常为出版物写稿的人。

normal.en: Smoking can be a contributor to disease — it brings its influence to the outcome.
normal.cn: 吸烟可以是疾病的 contributor——它把影响带到结果中。

abstract.en: Think of the -or suffix as 'the person who': contributor = the person who contributes.
abstract.cn: 把 -or 后缀想成「……的人」：contributor = 贡献的人。

abstract.en: Think of a magazine's masthead listing writers: each is a contributor.
abstract.cn: 想象杂志刊头列出作者名单：每位都是 contributor。

abstract.en: Think of a person dropping a coin in a donation box: that person is a contributor.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人往捐款箱投硬币：那个人就是 contributor。

examples.en: The magazine thanked its contributors in the last issue.
examples.cn: 该杂志在上一期中感谢了其投稿人。

examples.en: Anonymous contributors donated over a million dollars.
examples.cn: 匿名捐款者捐赠了超过一百万美元。

examples.en: Lack of exercise is a major contributor to obesity.
examples.cn: 缺乏锻炼是肥胖的主要促成因素。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康吹布尤特」——康（con）师傅把部落（tribuere）的一份聚到一起的人 → contributor 贡献者

root: 拉丁 contribuere「聚到一起、出一份」（con-「一起」+ tribuere「分配」）；contribut- 词干 + -or「做……的人」名词后缀。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all name 'one who gives a share': people who give money, writing, or effort, and factors that help cause outcomes.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都命名「出一份的人」：给钱、给文字、给努力的人，以及帮助导致结果的因素。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand placing a share into a common basket.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把一份放进共同的篮子。

branches.en: GENERAL GIVER: someone who adds to a common purpose.
branches.cn: 一般给予者：为共同目的添砖加瓦的人。

branches.en: FINANCIAL DONOR: someone who pays money.
branches.cn: 财务捐赠者：付钱的人。

branches.en: WRITTEN CONTRIBUTOR: a writer for publication.
branches.cn: 文字投稿者：出版物的作者。

branches.en: CAUSAL FACTOR: something that helps cause a result.
branches.cn: 因果因素：帮助导致结果的事物。

branches.en: PROJECT PARTICIPANT: someone who takes part in and helps a project or activity.
branches.cn: 项目参与者：参与并帮助项目或活动的人。

intro.en: Contributor is contribute + -or. The suffix -or is productive; the inner parts are fossilized.
intro.cn: contributor 是 contribute + -or。后缀 -or 有能产性；内部部分已凝固。

latinIntro.en: Latin tribuere 'to assign' produced contribute, distribute, attribute, tribute, tribe. Root: tribu-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tribuere「分配」产生了 contribute、distribute、attribute、tribute、tribe。词根：tribu-。

definition_zh: adj. 痛悔的，悔罪的
definition_en: feeling deeply sorry for something wrong you did
core_image: 一个人低头站着，手里攥着弄坏的东西
scene: 他把打碎的杯子扫干净，痛悔地道歉。Contrite, he swept up the broken cup and apologised.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contrite 指痛悔的；句意是他扫净碎片并痛悔道歉。

senses.title: Deeply sorry
senses.definition: feeling sharp regret for a wrong done
senses.definitionCN: 因做错事而深深懊悔
senses.example: He was contrite about the broken cup.
senses.exampleCN: 他为打碎杯子而痛悔。
senses.why: A head bowed over what is broken.
senses.whyCN: 对着碎片低下的头。

senses.title: Showing remorse
senses.definition: expressed in a humble, sorry way
senses.definitionCN: 以谦卑抱歉的方式表达
senses.example: She wrote a contrite note.
senses.exampleCN: 她写了一张表示悔意的便条。
senses.why: A short letter with a lowered tone.
senses.whyCN: 语气放低的短笺。

senses.title: Repentant in religion
senses.definition: sorrowful for sin in a religious sense
senses.definitionCN: 宗教意义上为罪过而懊悔
senses.example: The contrite pilgrims knelt in prayer.
senses.exampleCN: 悔罪的朝圣者跪地祈祷。
senses.why: A kneeler in a quiet chapel.
senses.whyCN: 安静小教堂里的跪凳。

intro.en: Contrite comes from Latin contritus, worn down or bruised.
intro.cn: contrite 来自拉丁语 contritus，意为被磨碎、被压伤。

items.en: Terere means to rub or grind.
items.cn: terere 意为摩擦、磨碎。

items.en: Conterere means to grind down completely.
items.cn: conterere 意为彻底磨碎。

items.en: Contritus means bruised, worn down.
items.cn: contritus 意为被压伤、被磨碎。

items.en: Church Latin used it for a crushed heart.
items.cn: 十三世纪教会拉丁语用它形容破碎的心。

items.en: English kept the sorrowful sense.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语保留了这层哀悔之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contr- start; the near-meaning group names regret.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contr- 开头；近义组都表示悔意。

normalIntro.en: Contrite is a heart ground down by regret.
normalIntro.cn: contrite 是被悔意磨碎的一颗心。

normal.en: Terere means to grind.
normal.cn: terere 意为磨。

normal.en: Conterere grinds something down.
normal.cn: conterere 是把它磨碎。

normal.en: A contrite person feels ground down.
normal.cn: 痛悔的人像被磨碎了一样。

normal.en: Contrite apologies are short and low.
normal.cn: 痛悔的道歉往往短而低。

normal.en: Contrition is the noun of that sorrow.
normal.cn: contrition 就是这份痛悔的名词。

abstract.en: A bowed head over broken glass.
abstract.cn: 对着碎玻璃低下的头。

abstract.en: A heart worn thin with regret.
abstract.cn: 被悔意磨薄的心。

abstract.en: A letter written in a small voice.
abstract.cn: 用小声气写成的信。

examples.en: He looked contrite after the quarrel.
examples.cn: 吵完架后他一脸痛悔。

examples.en: She sent a contrite apology.
examples.cn: 她发来一封痛悔的道歉。

examples.en: The contrite pilgrims knelt to pray.
examples.cn: 悔罪的朝圣者跪下祈祷。

dict_mnemonic.text: con（彻底）+ trit（磨）+ e → 被磨碎的心，即痛悔的。

root: 拉丁 con（彻底）+ terere（磨）→ contritus（被磨碎的）→ 英语 contrite

sensesIntro.en: A wrong done, and a heart ground down by it.
sensesIntro.cn: 做错一件事，心被它磨碎。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heart ground down by regret
core.cn: 核心意象：被悔意磨碎的心

branches.en: Sorry over a broken cup.
branches.cn: 为打碎的杯子而懊悔。

branches.en: A note that lowers its voice.
branches.cn: 语气放低的便条。

branches.en: Pilgrims kneeling in sorrow.
branches.cn: 痛悔跪地的朝圣者。

branches.en: Regret that is spoken aloud.
branches.cn: 说出口的悔意。

branches.en: A heart crushed by its own sin.
branches.cn: 被自身罪过压碎的心。

intro.en: Contrite carries the prefix con- and the root terere, to grind.
intro.cn: contrite 带前缀 con- 与表「磨」的词根 terere。

latinIntro.en: Latin contritus means worn down or bruised.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 contritus 意为被磨碎、被压伤的。

definition_zh: v. 设法做到；谋划；设计
definition_en: to manage something cleverly, or to plan and invent
core_image: 几个人用绳子与木板临时搭起一架吊梯
scene: 没有梯子，他们设法用绳子把箱子吊了上去。With no ladder, they contrived to lift the box with ropes.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contrive 指设法做到；句意是他们用绳子把箱子吊上去。

senses.title: Manage to do
senses.definition: to succeed in doing something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 成功做到难办的事
senses.example: They contrived to lift the box.
senses.exampleCN: 他们设法把箱子抬了起来。
senses.why: A rope and a plank doing a ladder job.
senses.whyCN: 绳子和木板干起了梯子的活。

senses.title: Plan or scheme
senses.definition: to plan something in a clever way
senses.definitionCN: 巧妙地筹划某事
senses.example: He contrived a meeting with the minister.
senses.exampleCN: 他设法安排了与部长的会面。
senses.why: A move worked out several steps ahead.
senses.whyCN: 提前算好几步的一招。

senses.title: Invent or design
senses.definition: to make or design something new
senses.definitionCN: 制作或设计出新的东西
senses.example: She contrived a simple pump.

scene: 手术后她在乡下静养，慢慢康复。After surgery she stayed in the country to convalesce.

definition_zh: 对流；靠流体流动传递热量；对流环流
definition_en: the transfer of heat by the movement of a fluid such as air or water
core_image: 锅底受热的水向上涌起，表面的冷水下沉，形成一圈不断滚动的环流
scene: 厨房里，热空气在烤箱内被风扇推着循环，厨师说 In a convection oven, moving air carries heat to every shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 convection 指「靠流体流动把热从一个地方带到另一个地方」（第 4 个义项：烤箱内用风扇制造强制对流，使各层受热均匀）；句意为在对流烤箱里，流动的空气把热送到每一层架子。图中可辨识物件：烤箱、风扇、热气流箭头、烤盘。

senses.title: Heat carried by a moving fluid
senses.titleCN: 流体流动带走热量的传热方式
senses.definition: heat transfer in which the heated fluid itself moves and carries thermal energy with it
senses.definitionCN: 受热的流体本身发生移动，并把热能一起带走的传热方式
senses.example: Water at the bottom of the pot warms and rises by convection.
senses.exampleCN: 锅底的水受热后靠对流上升。
senses.why: Latin convehere means 'to carry together', so convection is literally heat being carried along by a moving medium.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 convehere 意为「一起搬运」，因此对流字面上就是热被流动的介质带着走。

senses.title: Rising air in the atmosphere
senses.definition: the vertical movement of warm, moist air that rises and cools, often forming clouds
senses.definitionCN: 暖湿空气上升并冷却的垂直运动，常形成云
senses.example: Afternoon convection built a tall column of cloud over the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 午后的对流在山丘上空堆起一根高高的云柱。
senses.why: The atmosphere is a fluid, so the same physical process is watched on a weather-chart scale.
senses.whyCN: 大气也是流体，因此同一物理过程被放在天气图的尺度上观察。

senses.title: Slow flow inside the Earth
senses.definition: the very slow circulation of hot rock in the mantle that helps drive plate motion
senses.definitionCN: 地幔中炽热岩石的极缓慢环流，它推动板块运动
senses.example: Mantle convection is too slow to see but strong enough to move continents.
senses.exampleCN: 地幔对流慢到看不见，却强到足以移动大陆。
senses.why: The medium here is solid rock behaving like an extremely viscous fluid over geological time.
senses.whyCN: 这里的介质是岩石，只是在漫长的地质时间里表现得像极黏稠的流体。

senses.title: Forced convection in appliances
senses.definition: convection driven by a fan or pump rather than by temperature differences alone
senses.definitionCN: 由风扇或泵而非单纯温差驱动的对流
senses.example: The convection oven finishes the roast in less time than a still oven.
senses.exampleCN: 对流烤箱比普通静置烤箱更快把肉烤好。
senses.why: Adding a fan turns a natural tendency into an engineered process, but the name of the process stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 加一个风扇把自然趋势变成工程过程，但过程的名称不变。

senses.title: A circulating loop of fluid
senses.definition: a closed loop in which warm fluid rises at one place and cool fluid sinks at another
senses.definitionCN: 暖流体在一处上升、冷流体在另一处下沉所形成的闭合环路
senses.example: A convection current in the room kept the smoke moving toward the door.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里的对流环流让烟一直朝门口飘。
senses.why: The loop is the visible shape the process takes, so the same word names the circulation and its cause.
senses.whyCN: 这个环路是过程呈现出的可见形状，因此同一个词既指环流也指其成因。

senses.title: Rain produced by rising air
senses.definition: heavy rain that falls when warm air rises quickly, cools and condenses in a tall cloud
senses.definitionCN: 暖空气迅速上升、冷却并在高云中凝结后落下的大雨
senses.example: Convection brought a short, violent storm just after noon.
senses.exampleCN: 对流在刚过正午时带来一场短促的暴雨。
senses.why: Meteorology names the rainfall after its cause, so convection stands for the whole convective weather event.
senses.whyCN: 气象学以成因给降雨命名，因此 convection 也代表整个对流性天气事件。

senses.title: Figurative spread of feeling or ideas
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：情绪或思想的涌动传播
senses.definition: the spreading of excitement, anger or ideas through a group as if carried by a rising current
senses.definitionCN: 兴奋、愤怒或思想像被上升气流带着一样在群体中扩散
senses.example: A convection of rumour moved through the office before lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭前，一股谣言的暗流在办公室里涌动。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the physics: something hot rises and carries other things with it.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了物理内核：热的东西上升，并带走别的东西。

senses.title: The convective layer of a star
senses.definition: the outer region of a star where energy is carried outward by rising and sinking gas
senses.definitionCN: 恒星外部由气体升降把能量向外输送的区域
senses.example: The Sun's convection zone churns plasma beneath the visible surface.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳的对流层在可见表面之下翻搅着等离子体。
senses.why: Astrophysics applies the terrestrial fluid process to gas on a stellar scale.
senses.whyCN: 天体物理学把地球上的流体过程套用到恒星尺度的气体上。

intro.en: Convection comes from Latin convehere 'to carry together', built on com- 'together' and vehere 'to carry'. The noun convectio existed in Latin, and English first used the word for conveying before it became a term of physics.
intro.cn: convection 来自拉丁语 convehere「一起搬运」，由 com-「一起」与 vehere「搬运」构成。拉丁语本有名词 convectio；英语最初用它表示「传送」，后来才成为物理术语。

items.en: Vehere meant 'to carry, convey', with the past participle vectus; it is the source of vehicle and vector.
items.cn: vehere 意为「搬运、运送」，过去分词为 vectus；它是 vehicle 与 vector 的来源。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus vehere produced convehere 'to carry or bring together'.
items.cn: com-「一起」加 vehere 构成 convehere「一起搬运、聚集」。

items.en: The action noun convectio 'a bringing together, conveyance' supplied the shape of the English word.
items.cn: 动作名词 convectio「聚拢、运送」提供了英语词的形态。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the seventeenth century in the general sense of conveying; the physical sense developed later.
items.cn: 英语在 17 世纪借入这个词，泛指「传送」；物理义后来才发展出来。

items.en: The heat-transfer sense belongs to the nineteenth century, when heat was studied as a fluid-like quantity; the exact first use is uncertain.
items.cn: 传热义属于 19 世纪，当时热被当作类流体来研究；确切的最早使用不确定。

note.en: Group one holds words that resemble convection in form but come from other roots; group two holds the other modes of heat transfer and related circulation terms.
note.cn: 第一组是形式相近但词根不同的词；第二组是其他传热方式与相关的环流词。

entries.definition: From Latin convenire 'to come together', built on venire 'to come', not vehere 'to carry'; it means a custom or a meeting.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 convenire「聚到一起」，词根是 venire「来」而非 vehere「搬运」；意为惯例或会议。

entries.definition: From convertere 'to turn around', with the root vertere 'to turn'; it names a change of form or belief.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 convertere「转向」，词根为 vertere「转」；指形式或信仰的改变。

entries.definition: From convexus 'arched', with no carrying element at all; it describes a surface curving outward.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 convexus「拱起的」，完全没有「搬运」成分；形容向外凸起的表面。

entries.definition: Through Old French from Latin convehere: to carry something or to communicate an idea, but not the scientific process.
entries.definitionCN: 经古法语来自拉丁 convehere：搬运某物或传达想法，但不是科学过程。

entries.definition: Heat passing through a solid by direct contact between particles, with no bulk movement of the material.
entries.definitionCN: 热通过粒子间的直接接触穿过固体，物质本身不发生整体移动。

entries.definition: Heat travelling as electromagnetic waves, needing no medium at all.
entries.definitionCN: 热以电磁波形式传播，完全不需要介质。

entries.definition: The horizontal carrying of heat or moisture by wind; convection is mainly vertical, advection mainly horizontal.
entries.definitionCN: 风把热或水汽水平搬运；对流主要是垂直的，平流主要是水平的。

entries.definition: The movement of a fluid around a closed path; it is the shape convection takes, not the heat-transfer mechanism.
entries.definitionCN: 流体沿闭合路径的运动；它是对流呈现的形状，而非传热机制本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin morphemes, real compounds and real physics collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁构词成分、真实复合词与真实物理搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: con- 'together' + vehere 'carry': the fluid carries heat along with it.
normal.cn: con-「一起」+ vehere「搬运」：流体把热一起带走。

normal.en: The same root appears in convey, vehicle and vector.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 convey、vehicle 与 vector 中。

normal.en: Physics pairs it with conduction and radiation as the three modes of heat transfer.
normal.cn: 物理学把它与 conduction、radiation 并列为三种传热方式。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: convection oven, convection current, mantle convection.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：对流烤箱、对流环流、地幔对流。

normal.en: The adjective is convective and the verb is convect, both built on the same stem.
normal.cn: 形容词是 convective，动词是 convect，都基于同一词干。

abstract.en: Picture a pot of soup where the hot part climbs and the cool part dives, over and over.
abstract.cn: 想象一锅汤，热的部分往上爬，冷的部分往下沉，周而复始。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour rising in one office and drifting down into the next.
abstract.cn: 想象一则谣言在一间办公室升起，又飘进下一间。

abstract.en: Picture a slow stone river under the continents, moving a centimetre a year.
abstract.cn: 想象大陆之下一条缓慢的石河，一年只移动一厘米。

examples.en: Convection carries heat from the radiator to the far side of the room.
examples.cn: 对流把热从暖气片带到房间的另一头。

examples.en: The storm was fuelled by strong convection over warm water.
examples.cn: 暖水面上强烈的对流给这场风暴提供了能量。

examples.en: Geologists model mantle convection to explain continental drift.
examples.cn: 地质学家模拟地幔对流来解释大陆漂移。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一起背」——热和水汽一起被背着往上走，就是对流

root: 拉丁 convehere「一起搬运」= com-「一起」+ vehere「搬运、运送」，动作名词 convectio。英语 17 世纪借入时泛指「传送」，19 世纪才固定为传热术语；该物理义的最早书证不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: a moving fluid picks up heat and carries it away, whether in a pot, the sky, the mantle, an oven, a room, a storm, a crowd or a star.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线索展开：流动的流体带走热量，无论在锅里、天空、地幔、烤箱、房间、风暴、人群中还是恒星里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: warm water rising at the bottom of a pot while cooler water sinks.
core.cn: 核心意象：锅底的热水上升，较冷的水下沉。

branches.en: PROCESS AND LOOP: the same word names the carrying and the circulating shape it makes.
branches.cn: 过程与环路：同一个词既指搬运，也指它形成的环流形状。

branches.en: WEATHER: rising air builds cloud and then releases rain.
branches.cn: 天气：上升的空气堆起云，随后落下雨。

branches.en: DEEP AND HIGH: the process works in mantle rock and in stellar gas.
branches.cn: 深处与高处：这一过程既发生在地幔岩石里，也发生在恒星气体里。

branches.en: ENGINEERED AIR: a fan turns natural convection into a controlled oven process.
branches.cn: 工程气流：风扇把自然对流变成可控的烤箱过程。

branches.en: SOCIAL CURRENT: excitement and rumour rise and spread like warm air.
branches.cn: 社会气流：兴奋与谣言像暖空气一样上升扩散。

intro.en: Convection is a Latin prefix, root and suffix laid end to end: con- plus vehere plus -tion. The same pieces build convey and convection's scientific relatives.
intro.cn: convection 是拉丁前缀、词根与后缀依次相接：con- 加 vehere 加 -tion。相同的成分还构成 convey 与对流的相关科学词。

latinIntro.en: Latin vehere gives a real family: vehere itself, the compound convehere, the action noun convectio, and the participle vectus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 vehere 给出一个真实的词族：vehere 本身、复合词 convehere、动作名词 convectio 以及分词 vectus。

items.example: The prefix joins the carrying action to a group.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把搬运动作收拢到一个整体里。

items.example: The root underlies vehicle and vector.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根是 vehicle 与 vector 的基础。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: The suffix turns convect into the name of a process.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把 convect 变成过程之名。

items.meaning: to move heat by fluid motion
items.example: The fan convects warm air through the room.
items.exampleCN: 风扇让暖空气在房间里对流。

branches.en: The meeting sense gathers the people themselves.
branches.cn: 大会义把人本身聚起来。

branches.en: A custom and a treaty are both agreed rules.
branches.cn: 习俗与条约都是议定的规则。

branches.en: People who write rules must first come together.
branches.cn: 写规则的人，总要先聚到一起。

intro.en: Convention is built on Latin com-, together, plus venire, to come.
intro.cn: convention 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 venire（来）构成。

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convene, convenient and event.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convene、convenient 与 event 中。

items.meaning: a coming together and what is agreed
items.meaningCN: 聚到一起以及所议定的事

items.meaning: a way by which one comes
items.example: The avenue was lined with trees.

items.meaning: to come before and stop something
items.meaningCN: 先一步到来并加以阻止

definition_zh: 传统的；惯例的；常规的
definition_en: following the usual and accepted way of doing things
core_image: 一整排相同的窗子，尺寸和间距都一样
scene: 邻居都装同样的白窗帘，只有她挂了一块彩布。Her house stands out among the conventional ones.
sceneCN: 这里 conventional 指「传统的」（第 1 个义项：按多数人接受的方式行事）；句意是她的房子在那些传统样式的房子中格外显眼。

senses.title: Following custom
senses.definition: acting in the way most people in a society accept
senses.definitionCN: 按社会多数人接受的方式行事
senses.example: They chose a conventional name for the baby.
senses.exampleCN: 他们给宝宝取了个传统的名字。
senses.why: A well-worn path is easy to walk, and easy to notice.
senses.whyCN: 走熟的路好走，也容易被人看见。

senses.title: Usual in method
senses.definition: standard rather than special or new
senses.definitionCN: 采取标准做法而非特殊或新颖的做法
senses.example: The farm uses conventional tools.
senses.exampleCN: 这个农场使用常规工具。
senses.why: Most work is done with what has already been tested.
senses.whyCN: 多数活儿是用已经验过的东西干的。

senses.title: Lacking surprise
senses.definition: plain and not unusual, sometimes in a dull way
senses.definitionCN: 普通、毫不特别，有时显得乏味
senses.example: The ending was too conventional to remember.
senses.exampleCN: 这个结尾太落套，让人记不住。
senses.why: A picture that copies every other picture leaves no mark.
senses.whyCN: 一张照抄其他画的画，不会留下痕迹。

intro.en: Conventional is convention plus the adjective ending -al, from Latin convenire, to come together and agree.
intro.cn: conventional 是 convention 加形容词词尾 -al 构成，源头是拉丁语 convenire（走到一起并取得一致）。

items.en: Convenire meant to meet and to agree.
items.cn: convenire 意为会面并取得一致。

items.en: Conventio named the agreement that followed a meeting.
items.cn: conventio 指会面之后达成的约定。

items.en: French convention carried the sense of an accepted custom.
items.cn: 法语 convention 带有被接受的习俗之义。

items.en: English convention meant a settled habit of a group.
items.cn: 英语 convention 指群体固定的习惯。

items.en: The adjective conventional grew to mean following that habit.
items.cn: 形容词 conventional 逐渐指依照这种习惯。

items.en: It now also hints at a lack of freshness.
items.cn: 如今它也暗示缺少新意。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin coming base ven-, and the meaning group names other words for what follows the usual path.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的来词基 ven-，近义组列出其他表示循常规的词。

entries.definition: an accepted habit or a large meeting
used as the usual accepted model

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a well-worn path, then move to tested tools and to a picture that copies every other picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从走熟的路开始，再到验过的工具，最后到照抄别的画的那幅画。

normal.en: Conventional is the adjective of convention: it follows the accepted way.
normal.cn: conventional 是 convention 的形容词：它照着被接受的方式走。

normal.en: A row of identical windows is convention in stone.
normal.cn: 一排一模一样的窗子，是石头做成的惯例。

normal.en: Conventional wisdom is what everyone says before thinking.
normal.cn: 传统看法是大家还没想就都会说的话。

normal.en: The word can praise safety or blame dullness.
normal.cn: 这个词既能夸稳妥，也能怪乏味。

normal.en: Same path, same steps, same result.
normal.cn: 同一条路，同样的步子，同样的结果。

abstract.en: Picture ten houses with the same white front.
abstract.cn: 想象十座房子有着同样的白色门面。

abstract.en: Picture a row of tools worn smooth by years.
abstract.cn: 想象一排被岁月磨得光滑的工具。

abstract.en: Picture a painting copied line for line from another.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅画逐线照抄了另一幅。

examples.en: She prefers conventional clothes at work.
examples.cn: 上班时她更喜欢传统样式的衣服。

examples.en: The farmers still use conventional methods.
examples.cn: 这些农民仍使用常规方法。

examples.en: His solution was clever but conventional.
examples.cn: 他的办法聪明却很落套。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conventional 记成 convention（惯例）加 al（形容词尾）：凡事照着惯例走，就是传统的、常规的。

root: 由 convention（惯例、约定）加形容词词尾 -al 构成，源头是拉丁语 convenire（走到一起并取得一致），指循惯例、合常规与缺少新意。

sensesIntro.en: From walking a well-worn path, to using tested tools, and at last to copying a picture already seen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从走一条熟路，到使用验过的工具，最后到照抄一幅已经看过的画。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ten houses sharing one white front.
core.cn: 核心意象：十座房子共用一个白色门面。

branches.en: The first sense simply follows what people accept.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是照着人们接受的做法。

branches.en: The second sense chooses the standard tool.
branches.cn: 第二个义项选用标准的工具。

branches.en: The third sense notices what the habit costs.
branches.cn: 第三个义项看出这种习惯付出的代价。

branches.en: Custom and standard method are close neighbours.
branches.cn: 习俗与标准方法是一对近邻。

branches.en: A tested way can also become a dull one.
branches.cn: 验过的路，也可能变成乏味的路。

intro.en: Conventional is convention plus the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: conventional 由 convention 加形容词词尾 -al 构成。

latinIntro.en: The coming base ven- also appears in convention, convene and prevent.
latinIntro.cn: 来词基 ven- 也出现在 convention、convene 与 prevent 中。

definition_zh: 交谈；谈话；会话
definition_en: an informal talk between people, or a serious discussion of a subject
core_image: 两人隔桌而坐，话语像球一样来回抛，始终不落地
scene: 咖啡馆里，两个人从天气聊到童年，一小时很快过去。Their conversation lasted until the shop closed.
sceneCN: 这里 conversation 指「交谈」（第 1 个义项：人们之间轻松的谈话）；句意是他们的交谈一直持续到店铺关门。

senses.title: An informal talk
senses.definition: a relaxed talk between two or more people
senses.definitionCN: 两人或多人之间轻松的谈话
senses.example: We had a long conversation about school.
senses.exampleCN: 我们聊了很久学校的事。
senses.why: Two voices taking turns is the oldest way to share a day.
senses.whyCN: 两个声音轮流开口，是分享一天最古老的方式。

senses.title: A serious discussion
senses.definition: a formal discussion of a subject between people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 个人或团体之间就某话题进行的正式讨论
senses.example: The two sides held a conversation on trade.
senses.exampleCN: 双方就贸易问题举行了会谈。
senses.why: When the stakes are high, a talk puts on a formal coat.
senses.whyCN: 事关重大时，谈话就披上了一件正式的外衣。

senses.title: The exchange itself
senses.definition: the act of talking together rather than any single remark
senses.definitionCN: 指一起谈话这一行为，而非某一句单独的话
senses.example: Conversation is how children learn their first words.
senses.exampleCN: 会话是孩子学会最初词汇的方式。
senses.why: A single line is a stone; a conversation is the river.
senses.whyCN: 一句话是一块石头，一次会话是一条河。

intro.en: Conversation comes from Latin conversari, to live or keep company with, built from com-, together, and versare, to turn.
intro.cn: conversation 来自拉丁语 conversari（与人相处、往来），由 com-（一起）与 versare（转动）构成。

items.en: Versare meant to turn something again and again.
items.cn: versare 意为把某物反复转动。

items.en: Conversari meant to live among people and spend time with them.
items.cn: conversari 意为在人群中生活、与人相处。

items.en: Conversatio named a way of life and daily dealings with others.
items.cn: conversatio 指生活方式以及与人的日常往来。

items.en: Old French conversation named a familiar talk between people.
items.cn: 古法语 conversation 指人与人之间的熟络谈话。

items.en: English conversation first meant living or dealing with people.
items.cn: 英语 conversation 最初指与人共同生活或往来。

items.en: Today it means a talk, usually friendly and unhurried.
items.cn: 今天它指一场谈话，通常友好而不慌不忙。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin turning base vers-, and the meaning group names other kinds of talk.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的转动词基 vers-，近义组列出其他表示谈话的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two voices taking turns, then move to a formal talk between groups and to conversation as a habit of living.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两个声音轮流开口开始，再到团体之间的正式会谈，最后到作为一种生活习性的会话。

normal.en: Con- is together and vers is to turn, so a conversation is words turning between two people.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，vers 是转，conversation 就是在两人之间转来转去的话。

normal.en: One mouth alone is a speech; two mouths taking turns make a conversation.
normal.cn: 一张嘴独白是演讲，两张嘴轮流说才是交谈。

normal.en: The word looks like con plus version, as if each answer is a new version of the last.
normal.cn: 这个词看起来像 con 加 version，仿佛每个回答都是对上一句的新版本。

normal.en: A good conversation leaves both people slightly changed.
normal.cn: 一场好的交谈会让两个人都微微改变。

normal.en: No script, no stage: just two chairs turned toward each other.
normal.cn: 没有剧本，没有舞台，只有两把朝向彼此的椅子。

abstract.en: Picture a ball of words thrown gently back and forth.
abstract.cn: 想象一团话语被轻轻来回抛接。

abstract.en: Picture two cups on a table and steam rising between them.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上两只杯子，热气在两者之间升起。

abstract.en: Picture a river turning at every stone yet never stopping.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河绕过每块石头，却从不停下。

examples.en: They fell into conversation at the bus stop.
examples.cn: 他们在公交站随意聊了起来。

examples.en: I overheard a conversation about the new teacher.
examples.cn: 我无意中听到一段关于新老师的谈话。

examples.en: She keeps a notebook of conversations worth remembering.
examples.cn: 她把值得记住的谈话记在一个本子里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conversation 记成 con（一起）加 vers（转）加 ion（名词）：话在两人之间转来转去，就是交谈。

root: 源自拉丁语 conversari（与人相处、往来），由 com-（一起）与 versare（转动）构成，本指共同生活，后专指彼此交谈。

sensesIntro.en: From two voices taking turns, to a formal talk between groups, and at last to the whole habit of talking together.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两个声音轮流开口，到团体之间的正式会谈，最后到一起谈话这一整体习性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ball of words thrown gently back and forth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一团话语被轻轻来回抛接。

branches.en: A relaxed talk lets two people share an ordinary day.
branches.cn: 轻松的谈话让两个人分享平凡的一天。

branches.en: A formal talk carries weight and often has a purpose.
branches.cn: 正式的会谈有分量，通常带有目的。

branches.en: The habit of talking together is how a language is passed on.
branches.cn: 一起谈话的习性，正是语言得以传递的方式。

branches.en: Both are talk, differing only in tone and setting.
branches.cn: 两者都是谈话，只在语气与场合上不同。

branches.en: A single meeting and a lifelong habit both rest on exchange.
branches.cn: 一次会面与一生的习惯，都建立在交流之上。

intro.en: Conversation is built on Latin com-, together, plus versare, to turn, and the noun ending -ation.
intro.cn: conversation 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、versare（转动）与名词词尾 -ation 构成。

latinIntro.en: The turning base vers- also runs through convert, reverse and version.
latinIntro.cn: 转动词基 vers- 也贯穿 convert、reverse 与 version。

items.meaning: a talk that turns between people
items.meaningCN: 在人与人之间来回转的谈话

items.example: He wrote in a conversational style.
items.exampleCN: 他用谈话式的风格写作。

items.meaning: to turn something into another form
items.meaningCN: 把某物转成另一种形态
items.example: They convert the barn into a studio.
items.exampleCN: 他们把谷仓改成了工作室。

items.meaning: to turn something the other way
items.exampleCN: 他慢慢地把车倒了回去。

items.meaning: a form turned out from an original
items.meaningCN: 由原作转出的一种形态

definition_zh: v. 交谈；adj. 相反的；n. 相反的事物
definition_en: to talk with someone, or the opposite of something
core_image: 两个人坐在长椅上低声说话
scene: 他们坐在长椅上轻声交谈了一个下午。They sat on the bench and conversed quietly all afternoon.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：converse 指交谈；句意是他们在长椅上轻声交谈了一个下午。

senses.title: Talk together
senses.definition: to have a conversation with someone
senses.definitionCN: 与人进行对话
senses.example: They conversed in low voices.
senses.exampleCN: 他们低声交谈。
senses.why: Two heads leaning over one bench.
senses.whyCN: 长椅上凑近的两个脑袋。

senses.title: The opposite
senses.definition: the reverse of what was just said
senses.definitionCN: 与刚才所说相反的情况
senses.example: The converse is also true.
senses.exampleCN: 反过来也成立。
senses.why: A coin flipped to its other face.
senses.whyCN: 翻到另一面的硬币。

senses.title: Opposite in relation
senses.definition: reversed in order or direction
senses.definitionCN: 顺序或方向相反的
senses.example: The converse order also works.
senses.exampleCN: 相反的顺序也行。
senses.why: Two arrows pointing opposite ways.
senses.whyCN: 方向相反的两支箭。

intro.en: Converse joins Latin com-, together, to vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: converse 把拉丁语 com-（一起）接到 vertere（转）上。

items.en: Vertere means to turn.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动。

items.en: Convertere means to turn around.
items.cn: convertere 意为转过身去。

items.en: Conversari means to live or talk with others.
items.cn: conversari 意为与人相处、交谈。

items.en: English converse meant to associate.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语 converse 意为往来相处。

items.en: It settled into the sense of talking.
items.cn: 十六世纪固定为交谈之义。

note.en: The look-alike group is the same vertere family; the near-meaning group pairs talk with opposite.
note.cn: 形近组同属 vertere 词族；近义组把「交谈」与「相反」并列。

normal.en: Vertere means to turn.

normal.en: Conversari means to live and talk with others.
normal.cn: conversari 意为与人相处交谈。

normal.en: To converse is to turn words back and forth.

examples.en: They conversed in whispers.

examples.en: The converse is also true.

sensesIntro.cn: 话来回转是交谈，掉个头就是相反。

core.cn: 核心意象：转身相对交谈的两个人

branches.en: Words traded back and forth.

branches.en: A relation read the other way.

intro.en: Converse joins con-, together, to vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: converse 把表「一起」的 con- 接到表「转」的 vertere 上。

latinIntro.en: Latin conversari means to talk with others, and conversus means turned about.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 conversari 意为与人交谈，conversus 意为转过身。

definition_zh: 相反地；反过来
definition_en: in a way that reverses what has just been said
core_image: 一枚硬币翻到另一面，图案正好相反
scene: 北边下雪时，南方正晒着太阳，老师让学生把两地说法对调。The north is cold; conversely, the south is warm.
sceneCN: 这里 conversely 指「反过来」（第 1 个义项：引出与上文相反的说法）；句意是北方寒冷，反过来南方温暖。

senses.title: The other way round
senses.definition: used to introduce a statement that reverses the one just made
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出与刚才所说相反的一句话
senses.example: The north is cold; conversely, the south is warm.
senses.exampleCN: 北方寒冷，反过来，南方温暖。
senses.why: A coin has two faces, and naming one calls up the other.
senses.whyCN: 硬币有两面，说出一面就唤起了另一面。

senses.title: In inverse relation
senses.definition: used when two things move in opposite directions
senses.definitionCN: 用于两件事朝相反方向变化的情形
senses.example: Costs fell and, conversely, profits rose.
senses.exampleCN: 成本下降，反之利润上升。
senses.why: A seesaw shows that one end must sink for the other to lift.
senses.whyCN: 跷跷板说明一端必须下沉，另一端才会升起。

intro.en: Conversely is converse plus -ly; converse comes from Latin conversus, turned around, from com-, together, and vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: conversely 由 converse 加 -ly 构成；converse 来自拉丁语 conversus（转向的），由 com-（一起）与 vertere（转）构成。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn or change direction.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动或改变方向。

items.en: Conversus described something turned right round.
items.cn: conversus 形容某物被完全转过来。

items.en: English converse meant turned about or opposite.
items.cn: 英语 converse 意为转过来的、相反的。

items.en: The adverb conversely was formed to mark an opposite step in an argument.
items.cn: 副词 conversely 形成，用来在论述中标出一个相反的步骤。

items.en: It now usually opens a sentence that mirrors the one before.
items.cn: 今天它通常引出一个与上一句相对照的句子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin turning base vers-, and the meaning group names other ways of stating an opposite.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的转动词基 vers-，近义组列出其他表示相反的说法。

entries.definition: the act of changing into another form
to turn something the opposite way
in the opposite order or relation
in a way that goes against what was said

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a coin turned over, then move to two facts pulling in opposite directions.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一枚翻面的硬币开始，再到两件事朝相反方向拉扯。

normal.en: Converse is the opposite side, and -ly makes it an adverb, so conversely means on the opposite side.
normal.cn: converse 是相反的一面，加上 -ly 成为副词，conversely 就是在相反的一面。

normal.en: It always points back at the sentence you just read.
normal.cn: 它总是回头指向你刚读过的那句话。

normal.en: Think of a mirror placed beside a statement.
normal.cn: 想象在一句话旁边立起一面镜子。

normal.en: The signal is simple: the next clause will contradict the last.
normal.cn: 信号很简单：下一个分句会与上一个相反。

normal.en: It is the written cousin of saying on the other hand.

abstract.cn: 想象把一页纸翻过来露出背面。

abstract.en: Picture a scale tipping the other way.

examples.cn: 白天变短了，反过来，夜晚变长了。

examples.en: Rich soil holds water well and, conversely, sandy soil drains fast.
examples.cn: 肥沃的土壤保水好，反过来，沙土排水快。

examples.en: Conversely, a quiet room can make a small sound seem loud.
examples.cn: 反过来，安静的房间会让轻微的声音显得很响。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conversely 记成 converse（相反的）加 ly：以相反的方式说话，就是反过来。

root: 源自拉丁语 vertere（转）的过去分词 conversus（转过来的），加副词词尾 -ly，表示把话头转到相反的一面。

sensesIntro.en: From a single claim turned over, to two quantities moving in opposite directions.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把一句话翻到反面，到两个量朝相反方向变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a coin flipped to show its other face.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币翻过来露出另一面。

branches.en: A statement is reversed and set beside the first.
branches.cn: 一句话被反转，放在第一句旁边。

branches.en: Two quantities move apart, one rising as one falls.
branches.cn: 两个量彼此分开，一个升时一个降。

branches.en: Both uses mark a turn to the opposite side.
branches.cn: 两种用法都标记着转向相反的一面。

branches.en: The adverb keeps the reader from missing the reversal.
branches.cn: 这个副词让读者不会漏掉这次反转。

branches.en: It also signals a fixed inverse link between two facts.
branches.cn: 它也标示两件事之间固定的反向联系。

senses.title: Changing from one form to another
senses.definition: the process of changing something from one form, type, or use to another
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从一种形式、类型或用途变为另一种的过程
senses.example: The conversion of sunlight into electricity is solar power.
senses.exampleCN: 把阳光转化为电力就是太阳能发电。
senses.why: Latin vertere 'to turn' + con-: convertere means 'to turn around, change'.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 vertere「转」+ con-：convertere 意为「转身、改变」。

senses.title: A change of religion or belief
senses.definition: a change from one religion or belief to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一种宗教或信仰变为另一种的过程
senses.example: His conversion to Buddhism changed his life.
senses.exampleCN: 他皈依佛教改变了他的生活。
senses.why: When people convert, their beliefs 'turn around' to a new faith.
senses.whyCN: 当人们皈依时，他们的信仰「转身」投向新的宗教。

senses.title: A change of opinion or position
senses.definition: a change in one's opinion, attitude, or position
senses.definitionCN: 一个人观点、态度或立场的改变
senses.example: Her conversion to the cause surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这一事业的支持让所有人惊讶。
senses.why: A conversion of opinion is a turning from one view to another.
senses.whyCN: 观点的 conversion 是从一种看法转向另一种。

senses.title: The act of changing units
senses.definition: the act of changing one unit of measurement into another
senses.definitionCN: 把一种计量单位变为另一种的行为
senses.example: The conversion of miles to kilometers is straightforward.
senses.exampleCN: 英里换算成公里很简单。
senses.why: In math, conversion turns one measure into an equivalent one.
senses.whyCN: 在数学中，conversion 把一种度量变为等价的另一种。

senses.title: Changing property or money
senses.definition: the act of changing property or money into a different form
senses.definitionCN: 把财产或货币变为不同形式的行为
senses.example: The conversion of stocks to cash was quick.
senses.exampleCN: 股票兑换成现金很快。
senses.why: Financial conversion turns one asset into another form.
senses.whyCN: 财务 conversion 把一种资产变为另一种形式。

senses.title: In rugby, an extra score
senses.definition: in rugby, the scoring of extra points by kicking the ball over the bar after a try
senses.definitionCN: 橄榄球中，触地得分后把球踢过横梁而获得额外分数
senses.example: He scored the conversion to tie the game.
senses.exampleCN: 他踢进附加球扳平了比分。
senses.why: In rugby, a try is 'converted' into extra points by a successful kick.
senses.whyCN: 在橄榄球中，触地得分通过成功射门「转化」为额外分数。

senses.title: A change in function or purpose
senses.definition: the process of changing the function or purpose of something
senses.definitionCN: 改变某物功能或用途的过程
senses.example: The conversion of the barn into a theater was successful.
senses.exampleCN: 把谷仓改造成剧院很成功。
senses.why: When a building's use changes, it undergoes conversion.
senses.whyCN: 当一栋建筑的用途改变时，它就经历了 conversion。

senses.title: A change in computer data
senses.definition: the process of changing data from one format to another
senses.definitionCN: 把数据从一种格式变为另一种的过程
senses.example: The file conversion took several minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 文件转换花了几分钟。
senses.why: In computing, data is converted from one format to another for compatibility.
senses.whyCN: 在计算中，数据从一种格式转换为另一种以实现兼容。

intro.en: Conversion comes from Latin conversio, from convertere 'to turn around' (con- + vertere). The core image is turning something into another form.
intro.cn: conversion 来自拉丁 conversio，源自 convertere「转身」（con- + vertere）。核心意象是把某物变为另一种形式。

items.en: vertere meant 'to turn'. It is one of the most productive Latin roots in English.
items.cn: vertere 意为「转」。它是英语中能产性最高的拉丁词根之一。

items.en: con- adds 'together' or intensifies. convertere is 'to turn around, change'.
items.cn: con- 加上「一起」或加强语气。convertere 是「转身、改变」。

items.en: conversus, past participle of convertere, gave the stem used in English convert.
items.cn: conversus，convertere 的过去分词，提供了英语 convert 所用的词干。

items.en: conversio meant 'a turning around, change'. It was borrowed into French and English.
items.cn: conversio 意为「转身、改变」。它被借入法语和英语。

items.en: Conversion entered English in the 13th century from French conversion.
items.cn: conversion 在 13 世纪从法语 conversion 进入英语。

items.en: The word grew to cover religion, finance, computing, and sports.
items.cn: 该词扩展到宗教、金融、计算和体育领域。

note.en: The first group shares vertere; the second contains near-synonyms for change.
note.cn: 第一组共享 vertere；第二组是变化的近义词。

entries.definition: to change from one form to another; the verb behind conversion
entries.definitionCN: 从一种形式变为另一种；conversion 背后的动词

a thorough change in form or appearance; close to conversion
entries.definitionCN: 形式或外观的彻底改变；接近 conversion

entries.definition: the act of becoming different; broader than conversion

entries.definition: the process of changing to suit new conditions; close to the 'change of use' sense
entries.definitionCN: 改变以适应新条件的过程；接近「用途改变」义

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes and real word relatives.

normal.en: con- + vertere 'to turn': conversion is turning something into another form.
normal.cn: con- + vertere「转」：conversion 是把某物变成另一种形式。

normal.en: convert is the verb; conversion is the noun of the action or result.
normal.cn: convert 是动词；conversion 是动作或结果的名词。

normal.en: reverse (re-) turns back; convert (con-) turns around into something else.
normal.cn: reverse（re-）转回；convert（con-）转身变成别的东西。

normal.en: Religious conversion is a 'turning around' of one's beliefs.
normal.cn: 宗教皈依是信仰的「转身」。

normal.en: In rugby, a try is converted into extra points by a kick.
normal.cn: 在橄榄球中，触地得分通过射门转化为额外分数。

abstract.en: Think of a caterpillar turning into a butterfly: that is conversion of form.
abstract.cn: 想象毛毛虫变成蝴蝶：那是形式的 conversion。

abstract.en: Think of a U-turn: the direction turns around — conversion.
abstract.cn: 想象一个掉头：方向转了过来——conversion。

abstract.en: Think of one currency being changed into another: a financial conversion.
abstract.cn: 想象一种货币换成另一种：财务 conversion。

examples.cn: 仓库改造成办公室的工程上个月完工了。

examples.en: His conversion to vegetarianism surprised his family.
examples.cn: 他皈依素食主义让家人惊讶。

examples.en: The conversion rate from euros to dollars has changed.
examples.cn: 欧元兑美元的汇率变了。

branches.cn: 信仰或观点改变：意见或信念的转向。

branches.en: MEASURE OR ASSET CHANGE: units or money are turned into equivalents.
branches.cn: 度量或资产改变：单位或货币变为等价物。

branches.en: DATA FORMAT CHANGE: information is turned into another format.

branches.cn: 体育得分：触地得分转化为额外分数。

senses.title: To change form or use
senses.definition: to change something so that it takes a different form or serves a new purpose
senses.definitionCN: 改变某物，使其呈现另一种形态或有了新用途
senses.example: The barn was converted into a house.
senses.exampleCN: 这座谷仓被改造成了住宅。
senses.why: The same material can serve twice if the shape is changed.
senses.whyCN: 同样的材料，只要改变形状，就能再用一次。

senses.title: To change units or money
senses.definition: to change a value from one system or currency into another
senses.definitionCN: 把数值从一种体系或货币换成另一种
senses.example: You can convert pounds into dollars here.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以在这里把英镑换成美元。
senses.why: Two languages of counting need a bridge, and this verb is that bridge.
senses.whyCN: 两套计数语言之间需要桥，这个动词就是那座桥。

senses.title: A person who has changed belief
senses.definition: someone who has adopted a new religion or set of ideas
senses.definitionCN: 接受了新宗教或新观念的人
senses.example: He became a convert to the new method.
senses.exampleCN: 他转而拥护这种新方法。
senses.why: When a view turns a person around, the person is named after the turn.
senses.whyCN: 当一种看法把一个人转了个方向，人就用这次转向来命名。

intro.en: Convert comes from Latin convertere, to turn about, built from com-, together, and vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: convert 来自拉丁语 convertere（转过来），由 com-（一起）与 vertere（转）构成。

items.en: Vertere meant to turn, twist or change direction.
items.cn: vertere 意为转动、扭动或改变方向。

items.en: Convertere meant to turn something right round or turn it into another thing.
items.cn: convertere 意为把某物整个转过来，或把它变成另一样东西。

items.en: Conversus, the turned one, described a person or thing changed completely.
items.cn: conversus 指被转过来的人或物，形容彻底改变。

items.en: Old French convertir kept both the physical and the religious senses.
items.cn: 古法语 convertir 同时保留了物理与宗教两种含义。

items.en: English convert first meant to turn from one belief to another.
items.cn: 英语 convert 最初指从一种信仰转向另一种。

items.en: The word now also covers files, fuel and currency.
items.cn: 今天这个词也涵盖文件、燃料与货币的转换。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin turning base vert-, and the meaning group names other verbs of change.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的转动词基 vert-，近义组列出其他表示改变的动词。

normal.en: Same wood, new table: nothing is lost, only rearranged.

normal.en: A file becomes a picture, a pound becomes a dollar, a sum becomes a score.

normal.en: The noun convert is a person who has made this turn in belief.

abstract.cn: 想象两支箭头弯成一个圆。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp turned from a dark corner to a bright wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯从暗角转向明亮的墙面。

sensesIntro.en: From a thing turned into a new shape, to values exchanged, and at last to a person turned toward a new belief.
